title: The Price of the Fifth Page
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was digesting this earth-shattering truth, a mournful sigh echoed from the cracks of that turtle shell divine artifact—a whisper from the heavens.

text.content:
The jade slip hovered in mid-air, the power of the fifth page flowing like a living creature, each fluctuation tugging at Chen Ji's mind. He reached out, his fingertips touching the icy jade surface, and a torrent of primordial information instantly surged into his Mental Sea.

"The complete Tianji Record requires bearing the weight of fate for each page's use." Mo Xiansheng's residual soul voice sounded in his ear, carrying an unprecedented solemnity. "The fifth page allows glimpses into the extremes of Heavenly Secrets—the price is the dual剥离 of your lifespan and Heavenly Fate."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. What did this mean? Every use accelerated his own death.

dialogue.content:
I understand.

Chen Ji's voice was unexpectedly calm, as if he had long anticipated this moment. He stared at the flowing runes on the fifth page, the corner of his mouth even forming a bitter smile.

So the Tianji Record chose me, not because of talent, but because I'm sufficiently "expendable"? A servant disciple's life holds no value in the eyes of heaven—perfect for serving as a vessel.

text.content:
The jade slip trembled slightly, Mo Xiansheng's figure emerging in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, even more faint than before, as if it might dissipate at any moment.

"You're wrong." The residual soul guardian's voice was low. "The Tianji Record chose you because you're the only person in a thousand years who can withstand the fifth page's impact while incomplete. Beneath your mediocre exterior lies a qualification you yourself don't know about."

Upon hearing this, Chen Ji showed no relief—only a cold laugh escaped his lips.

dialogue.content:
Qualification?

He raised his left hand, five fingers spread open, the Heavenly Fate value appearing in his palm—only thirty-seven points remaining.

These thirty-seven points were earned crawling out of corpse piles, exchanged through countless near-death experiences. Now you're telling me I still have to fill this bottomless pit with my life?

choice.prompt: The fifth page's power was too tempting—futures spanning eternity, laid bare before his eyes. But the price was equally staggering. Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.description: Even with just thirty-seven points of Heavenly Fate, he'd take the gamble. The truth of eternity's future might change everything.
choices.visible_reward: Glimpse a Fraction of the Truth Across Eternity
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Will Drop to Twenty-Two Points, Approaching the Critical Line

text.id: 天机录_ch0892_result_冒险_使用第五页_001
text.content:
Chen Ji hesitated no longer. His left hand slammed onto the fifth page. In an instant, the world spun, his consciousness dragged into chaos. Countless images flashed by like a carousel—immortal-demon wars, heaven and earth shattering, and a vague figure standing atop the ruins, back turned to him.

That figure turned its head. Its face was obscured by light, but Chen Ji saw what it held in its hand—a turtle shell, identical to the divine artifact in his arms.

choices.text: Exercise Restraint, Study the Price First
choices.description: Can't act rashly. Heavenly Fate is down to thirty-seven points—I must understand the full price before deciding.
choices.visible_reward: Gain More Intelligence About the Tianji Record's Truth
choices.process_label: 陈机收回手，开始研究第五页...

text.content:
Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his impulse and pulled his hand back. He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into his Mental Sea, creating a deeper resonance with the Tianji Record's true form.

This time, he clearly saw those sealing runes—they weren't simple suppression, but a two-way chain. One end bound fate, the other bound the user themselves.

"The Tianji Record is both key and lock." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded. "If you want to unseal fate's seal, you must chain yourself to it as well."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze falling on the turtle shell divine artifact in his embrace.

At this moment, it emitted a faint glow, the surface cracks deeper than before. And within those fissures, a thread of golden markings was faintly visible—never-before-seen coloring, carrying a certain sacred and ancient aura.

"It's awakening." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare astonishment. "This turtle shell... is not of this realm."

dialogue.content:
Not of this realm?

Chen Ji took out the turtle shell and examined it closely. That golden thread spread through the cracks like blood vessels, each one emanating a terrifying pressure that made one's heart tremble.

What are you trying to say? Where did it come from?

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's residual soul fell silent for a long while before speaking slowly.

"The Heavenly Realm."

These two words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The hand holding the turtle shell trembled slightly—the Heavenly Realm, that legendary existence, where immortals dwell.

"In ancient times, the Heavenly Realm and mortal realm were not separated. This turtle shell is the shed skin left behind after some great Heavenly Realm being fell, acquired by chance by the first Tianji Record holder, and refined into a divination divine artifact."

Chen Ji's breathing quickened. A Heavenly Realm shed skin—no wonder this small turtle shell could bear the Tianji Record's power.

choice.prompt: The truth of the Heavenly Realm shed skin was too staggering. Chen Ji needed to decide how to handle this information.

choices.text: Inquire About the Heavenly Realm Connection
choices.description: Why would a Heavenly Realm shed skin end up in the mortal realm? There must be deeper secrets behind this. I must find out.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Be Hiding Something

text.content:
Chen Ji asked in a deep voice: "Who was that Heavenly Realm great one? Why did they fall? And where did they fall?"

Mo Xiansheng's figure flickered, as if hesitating.

"That great one... was called the 'Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor,' a divine beast that governed fate in the Heavenly Realm. Its fall has a direct connection to the Tianji Record's creation. As for where it fell—"

He paused, his voice dropping lower: "Right beneath your feet. Beneath the Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds lies the Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor's remains."

choices.text: Digest Information and Seek Another Opportunity
choices.description: Learning too much at once leads to mistakes. Take notes first, verify slowly later.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Not Volunteer More Information
choices.process_label: 陈机表面calm，内心飞速运转...

text.id: 天机录_ch0892_result_权衡_先消化情报_001
text.content:
Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, only nodding lightly.

So that's how it is.

He tucked the turtle shell back into his embrace, but his fingers subtly calculated within his sleeve. The Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds—that place successive sect masters have spoken of only in whispers. If it truly is the Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor's fall location, what has that old fox Ling Yuan been hiding in there?

Chen Ji's eyes flickered subtly, already forming his own plans. This thread of clues was enough to add another trump card to his future schemes.

At that moment, the cracks on the turtle shell's surface suddenly expanded violently.

"Crack—"

A crisp sound, golden markings spreading like a spider's web, wrapping around the entire turtle shell. At the same time, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—the Tianji Record's seal was counterattacking.

"Not good!" Mo Xiansheng exclaimed, "You used the fifth page's power just now, triggering the seal's emergency mechanism. It's forcibly absorbing your Heavenly Fate to stabilize itself!"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's face instantly turned pale. He sensed his Heavenly Fate draining at a near-uncontrollable rate—ten points, fifteen points, twenty points...

Stop!

He gritted his teeth, hands forming seals, attempting to sever the connection with the turtle shell. But those golden markings seemed alive, coiling tightly around his meridians—the harder he struggled, the tighter they wound.

text.content:
"This isn't an ordinary emergency mechanism." Mo Xiansheng's voice became urgent. "The seal is absorbing your Heavenly Fate to complete itself—it's evolving!"

Chen Ji's heart chilled. He understood—the Tianji Record wasn't satisfied with its incomplete state. It wanted to become truly complete. And he, this "vessel," was being devoured as nourishment.

Is this the price of completeness?

A trace of blood seeped from the corner of his mouth, but his eyes grew even colder. Being used as a chess piece, as nourishment—throughout his life, Chen Ji despised nothing more than such fates.

choice.prompt: The seal's evolution iscrazed absorbing Heavenly Fate. Chen Ji must decide immediately, or face mortal danger.

choices.description: Cut all ties with the Tianji Record at any cost. Let it sink back into slumber rather than be drained dry.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Life, Stop the Seal's Evolution
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record May Fall Into Permanent Slumber

text.id: 天机录_ch0892_result_冒险_强行切断连接_001
text.content:
Chen Ji bit through his tongue sharply, spraying essence blood onto the turtle shell. Blood offerings to heaven, fate severed by life—this was the last self-preservation method for Tianji Record users.

The golden markings struggled violently for a moment, then slowly retreated into the cracks. The turtle shell's light faded gradually, returning to its ancient, worn appearance.

But Chen Ji's face had turned as white as paper. Heavenly Fate—only nineteen points remained.

choices.description: Since it wants to suck from me, I'll suck from it. Claim the seal evolution's power as my own.
choices.visible_reward: May Gain Power Within the Seal
choices.risk_hint: Success Rate Extremely Low—Failure Means Death

text.id: 天机录_ch0892_result_冒险_反向吞噬封印_001
text.content:
A flash of madness appeared in Chen Ji's eyes. He reversed his meridian circulation, actually beginning to actively absorb those golden markings!

Intense pain shot through every limb and bone, as if ten thousand knives were cutting his flesh. But Chen Ji endured it resolutely. A blurry image surfaced in his Mental Sea—

A massive black turtle lay across the Void, surrounded by countless chains. Its eyes were closed, but its lips seemed to flutter slightly, as if speaking.

Chen Ji heard those two words clearly: "...Save me..."

Chen Ji jerked his eyes open, gasping for breath.

That image was too real, not like an illusion. The Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor—that ancient Heavenly Realm divine beast actually retained a thread of will? It was sealed deep within the Forbidden Grounds, suffering some torment?

"What did you see?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of tension.

Chen Ji gave no answer, only lowering his gaze to the turtle shell in his hand. Now within its cracks, that thread of golden markings had become even more concentrated, as if responding to something.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice hoarse but calm:

This turtle shell isn't an ordinary shed skin. It's part of the Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor—or rather, a distress signal it left behind.

He stood up, tucking the turtle shell close to his body. The Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor was sealed beneath the Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds; the Tianji Record was refined from its remains... So the question arises: who sealed this Heavenly Realm divine beast? And who had the audacity to refine its remains into a divine artifact?

The answer was already taking shape.

text.content:
Ling Yuan.

Chen Ji softly spoke that name. The Tianqing Sect's successive sect masters passed down not only the position of sect master, but also the Forbidden Grounds' secrets. Ling Yuan knew what lay within the Forbidden Grounds, knew of the Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor's existence—possibly even—he was the one who dared to desecrate this Heavenly Realm divine beast.

No wonder he had been striking at me in secret all along. No wonder the Tianji Record bypassed him to choose me. Not because I'm exceptional, but because I'm a variable in his scheme.

Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, a glacial chill flickering in his eyes: Old thing, I think I've guessed a few of your trump cards.

dialogue.content:
"You're correct." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly grew complex. "Ling Yuan's previous life was precisely the one who refined the Tianji Record using the Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor's remains. He reincarnated, always wanting to reclaim this 'unfinished masterpiece.'"

Chen Ji's pupils constricted slightly. Reincarnation? Ling Yuan was actually a reincarnator?

"Your appearance caused deviation in his plans. The Tianji Record chose a new vessel, no longer under his control. His secret attacks against you over these years weren't just targeting you—they were probing the Tianji Record's awakening level."

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, organizing the information in his mind.

Ling Yuan was the reincarnation of the one who refined the Tianji Record, wanting to reclaim this divine artifact. The Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor was sealed deep within the Forbidden Grounds, retaining a will calling for rescue. The Tianji Record was both key to sealing fate and a shackle binding its user—its completeness requires filling with the user's life.

And his cards: Heavenly Fate under twenty points, the Tianji Record's fifth page just used once, the turtle shell divine artifact fallen into slumber, the Forbidden Grounds' secrets barely uncovered.

The situation was very unfavorable. But there was still a way to break the deadlock.

While Chen Ji was lost in thought, footsteps echoed in the distance.

He immediately收敛气息, resuming that timid, mediocre appearance. A servant disciple's figure appeared at the door, carrying a bowl of medicine.

"Chen Shixiong, your medicine is ready."

Chen Ji took the medicine bowl, lowering his eyes in thanks. Only after the disciple left did he glance at the decoction in the bowl—merely ordinary Qi Supplementing Soup, nothing unusual.

But his gaze passed over the bowl, looking toward the window. The Tianqing Sect's sky remained gloomy, the calm before the storm drawing near.

He lifted the medicine bowl and drained it in one gulp.

Whether the path ahead led to dragon's pool or tiger's den, since Chen Ji had come this far, there was no reason to turn back. The Heavenly Fate Turtle Ancestor's plea for rescue, Ling Yuan's schemes, the Tianji Record's complete price—these mysteries intertwined, pointing toward a greater truth.

That ultimate existence manipulating everything—the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

Chen Ji set down the empty bowl, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his mouth: Think of using me as a chess piece? Then come try and see who devours whom in the end.

He rose and walked to the window, his gaze profound as an abyss. The next round of the game was about to begin.
